actions.title: Edit a slate
actions.description: mode "preview" shows the result without saving. Every edit names the revision it was made on: a canvas plan (notes and connections) sends expectedRevision, the revision slates.get returned; a workshop or map plan holds one operation with its own expectedRevision (workshop.revision), and saving it requires an Idempotency-Key. Without it the edit is refused with 400 invalid_request naming expectedRevision. On a workshop, workshop_edits makes 1 to 50 edits (add, move, rename, remove cards and lanes) by the rules people meet; a refusal answers 409 edit_refused with the sentence a person sees, and a move the rules refuse answers 409 move_refused. A saved workshop edit answers with a receiptId that undo_workshop_edit takes. A slate holds up to 8 boards: a workshop operation names its board (boardId, from slates.get boards[]); on a slate of several boards one that names none is refused with 400 board_required listing them. add_component adds a library component (components.list) beside the slate's notes and boards and answers with its boardId; it carries its own expectedRevision (the slate revision). A canvas plan saved by an agent is shown live on the slate as suggestions (outcome "suggested", 202) for people there to keep or discard, unless a person lets that agent edit directly; its new notes' ids work in the next edit.

The undo is saved as an edit (the revision goes up, every open canvas shows it) and answers the run it undid (undone). Workshop and map edits are undone with undo_workshop_edit. An agent undoes by the rules its edits meet: 423 agents_paused while people paused agents, 409 needs_direct_edit unless a person lets it edit directly. 409 nothing_to_undo when no edit of the caller is left to undo; 409 slate_changed when the slate changed while it was being saved (call again).

Open to anyone.
